title: Convert Tailwind CSS markup and examples into SIMAI Framework-safe markup
workflow: Confirm the source ownership, license status, and target SIMAI Framework surface.
Classify the source markup into utility, component, smart-component, and behavior zones.
Map only known Tailwind patterns to verified SIMAI Framework utilities or components.
Generate a conversion report with unmapped classes, assumptions, and manual QA notes.
Validate SIMAI Framework-ready output with strict class and component checks.
required_outputs: converted SIMAI Framework markup or conversion plan
